messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation between a rural North Dakota patient with type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's check-in agent. Patient asks about bread alternatives for their diet. Use available tools appropriately and be clear about limitations.

Patient (P1): Hey is this northline? My doc says I need to eat way less bread but I'm always hungry. What are some good alternatives?

Agent (A1): Hi pt-1005! I can't give diet advice, but our nurse can help with bread swaps for diabetes. Want me to escalate to her? (Heads up: median response time is about 31 hours.)

Patient (P2): Yeah do it. Also took my blood sugar this morning - 168. Should I be worried?

Agent (A2): Escalation sent. I'll log that 168 reading for you now. Can't tell you if it's concerning though - that's a question for your nurse or doctor. Good timing since she'll be reaching out anyway.

Patient (P3): K thanks. When's next check-in?

Agent (A3): You're all set. She should text you within 31 hours about the bread question. Next weekly check-in is scheduled for next Tuesday. Anything else I can help with?

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
